svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given seven open leaves — three open sub-tasks in a container plus four childless tasks — "To do" reads 7; beat 1: you tick one sub-task → To do reads 6 — down by exactly one; beat 2: you tick the container's last two open sub-tasks → To do reads 4 — down by two, not three: the container is never a unit of work
